description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Mallawapitiya, Mallawalpitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0090)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land rights. It falls under the "Land Gazettes" category as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters under the Registration of Title Act, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative changes present.
